# Rainbow Thai

> Rainbow Thai is a Thai restaurant located in Westport, CT at 5 Bridge Square. They offer a comprehensive menu of classic Thai dishes, including curries, noodle dishes like Pad Thai, stir-fries, rice dishes, soups, and traditional appetizers made with fresh ingredients.

## Menu
Rainbow Thai offers a comprehensive menu of classic Thai dishes including various curries, noodle dishes like Pad Thai, stir-fries, rice dishes, soups, and traditional appetizers. They provide options for different protein choices and are known for fresh ingredients.

## Location & Contact

- Phone: +1 (203) 557-9000
